messages:
hana: Quick report: after bumping python-sdk to 0.9.0 our repo's strict-mypy job started failing. Errors point at assignments from dict responses into generated pydantic models.

eli: can you paste the CI output?

hana: snippet:

```
app/services/client_wrapper.py:56: error: Expression of type \"str\" cannot be assigned to declared type \"Optional[str]\"  [assignment]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 34 source files)
```

hana: The client does `obj.title = resp[\"title\"]` where resp is inferred as MutableMapping[str, Any] -> mypy sees resp[...] as Any? but apparently it's str and conflicts with Optional[str] on the pydantic model field.

sergio: we changed generator to emit pydantic models for domain objects but didn't change the response stubs. Old pipeline emitted TypedDict for responses which made assignments type-compatible.

eli: so options are: 1) emit TypedDict responses again; 2) widen model fields to Any; 3) add `# type: ignore` on assignment sites; 4) add CLI flag to opt into typed responses.\\

hana: we prefer (1) or (4). (3) & (2) are bandaids. Many teams (including ours) run pyright in editors and mypy in CI. TypedDicts would help both.

sergio: agree. I'll prototype a `--emit-typed-responses` generator flag that emits TypedDicts for operation responses and updates client stubs to use them. It will be opt-in for 0.9.x and we can switch default in 1.0.0.

eli: another related ask: embeddings fields are `List[Any]` currently. For cases where schema indicates numbers we should emit `List[float]`. That will align Python SDK types with our Go SDK types.

sergio: good catch. I'll add a heuristic: if items.type == \"number\" -> List[float], if items.type == \"integer\" -> List[int], else List[Any].

ci-bot: CI job started: repo/python-sdk - branch feature/typed-responses - mypy stage

hana: could you also include an async sample in the samples/ folder showing typed responses + AsyncClient usage? Our onboarding docs would benefit.

sergio: yes, will add async sample plus a small mypy.ini and pyrightconfig.json demonstrating strict settings. Also planning to add `from __future__ import annotations` to generated modules to reduce forward-ref noise.

eli: awesome. Please include a short migration note in the changelog and a script or sed snippets to help teams temporarily add casts while migrating.

sergio: will do. PR ETA: WIP later today with tests that run both mypy and pyright against a tiny sample package. Will post the PR link here when ready.
